data.narrative:
Renaissance Fusion is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Francesco Volpe and Martin Kupp that has raised $60.5M to date. The valuation analysis employs a comparison set of 11 total comps (3 public, 8 private) in the nuclear energy sector, including same-stage and adjacent-stage peers such as Fuse Energy ($200M, Series A), Nano Nuclear Energy ($808M, Seed), and Valar Atomics ($6.0B, Series B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $60.5M raised proxy, implying a valuation of $121M. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-sector comparables yields a median valuation of $808M, with a range of $200M to $6.0B, reflecting material dispersion in early-stage nuclear valuations. The peer-median approach carries greater weight given the heterogeneity of stage progression multipliers in frontier tech.

The combined analysis supports a valuation range of $103M (low) to $929M (high), with a median of $464M. Key uncertainties include technology differentiation relative to the peer set, capital intensity and pathway to commercialization, and the durability of current public market multiples for nuclear assets. The wide range reflects genuine uncertainty in this early-stage, capital-dependent sector rather than model ambiguity.
